etwap_base_supply.meaning: stored lastETWAPBaseSupply exponential TWAP value used by _checkMintCap

etwap_updated_before_cap_check.meaning: whether the stored exponential TWAP was updated before _checkMintCap runs for the mint

deposits_blocked_flag.meaning: whether new deposits are blocked for users after the over-threshold mint

assumptions: The subsequent mint attempt is a valid deposit/liquidity operation by a user.
The over-threshold mint is the trigger scenario; the requirement applies to all users' deposits.
The ~1 hour freeze is approximate and not quantified.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric supply bound or the intended cap value, so the 'within intended supply bound' relation cannot be expressed numerically; the plan uses the report-stated deposit-blocking observable instead.

limitations: Formalizes only the deposits_blocked impact; the separate mint_reverts impact is not covered by this plan.
The condition narrows to the report's stale-zero-TWAP scenario rather than a general supply-bound predicate.
Exact freeze duration and ETWAP decay timing are not quantified.
